title: Stealth Addresses for Everyone: ENS as the Universal Stealth Meta-Registry
description:
ENS names resolve to one address, exposing the recipient's whole history. Stealth addresses (ERC-5564) fix this: one identity, a fresh address per payment. Fluidkey has generated 1M+ such addresses in production; we're now bringing that experience to everyone as a public good, ENS DAO-funded.

We present an ENSIP turning ENS into the universal stealth meta-address registry: text-record storage, CCIP-Read resolution, every gateway response verified onchain - funds can't be silently redirected. Production lessons and an open-source kit let any wallet add private ENS payments in minutes.
